du khaḥtshe da zhes pa'i sngags don no/ /rdo rje zab mo ste/ gzung 'dzin la sogs pa'i rtog pa dang bral ba'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ dzi na dzig ste/ de lta bu'i theg chen gyis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi rgyal ba dag las kyang rgyal ba'i phyir/ rdo rje blo gros te/ so so yang dag rig bzhi'i sgom pa yongs su rdzogs pas/ rdo rje ltar mi phyed cing mnyam pa med pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa'i phyir/ don bzhin rig pa ste/ blo gros zab mo dang ldan pa de nyid kyi phyir ro/ /de ltar thogs pa med pa'i shes rab kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams thugs su chud par 'gyur ba ni/ pradzñā dzña na zhes pa'i sngags don no/ /pha rol phyin pa kun rdzogs pa ste/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa bcu gnyis dang / dbyangs kyi yi ge bcu gnyis sbyar nas/ sngar bshad zin pa ltar/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par mnga' ba'i phyir/ sa rnams kun gyi rgyan dang ldan pa ste/ de yang sa bcu gnyis dang / yi ge bcu gnyis sbyar nas bshad zin pa ltar/ sa rnams nyid rgyan yin pas/ de dag dang ldan pa'i phyir/ rnam par dag pa ste/ phyin ci log thams cad dang bral ba'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ bdag med chos te/ phyin ci ma log pa'i don ston pa'i phyir/ yang dag ye shes te/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi 'bras bu la bslu ba med pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ zla 'od bzang zhes te/ ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba'i 'od zer zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ltar/ gsal zhing mdzes pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de ltar bdag med pa'i chos thugs su chud pas/ ye shes kyi bdag nyid can gyi sku brnyes pa ni/ dzñā na ka ya zhes pa'i sngags don no/ /brtson chen sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ste/ gzhan don gyis brtson 'grus mthar phyin pas/ gdul bya rnams 'dren par byed pa'i rang bzhin can gyi sgyu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa'i phyir/

rgyud kun gyi ni bdag po mchog ste/ sngags dang phyag rgya la sogs pa'i sprul pa sna tshogs pa'i gzugs kyis bya ba dang / spyod pa dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud thams cad la dbang sgyur ba'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar rgyud thams cad kyi bdag po mchog tu gyur pas na/ gsung gi 'khor lo thams cad skor ba ste/ wa gi shwa ra zhes pa'i sngags don no/ /rdo rje'i gdan ni ma lus pa dang ldan pa ste/ ting nge 'dzin ma lus pa'i rang bzhin can gyi rdo rje'i skyil mo krung bdud thams cad las rgyal bar byed pa nyid la gnas pa'i phyir/ ye shes sku rnams ma lus 'chang ba ste/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin yi ge lnga'i sngags kyi de kho na nyid kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir/ de yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos yongs su rdzogs pa'i mtshan ma dang mtshon par gyur pa ni/ chos thams can yi ge lngas mtshon pa ste/ a ni chos thams cad kyi sgo'o/ /ra ni chos thams cad rdul dang bral ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad thugs rje chen po'i chags pas chags par mdzad pa'o/ /pa ni skye ba med pa dang / thugs rje chen po'i thabs kyi bdag nyid du gyur pas don dam pa'o/ /tsa ni sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa'i spyod pa dang / de dag gi rgyu dang bral ba yin pa'i phyir/ na ni nam mkha' dang 'dra bar nye bar dmigs pa'i sgrib pa thams cad dang bral ba'i chos kyi mthar thug pa'o/ /zhes so/ /de ltar yi ge lnga'i rang bzhin ye shes lnga'i sku 'chang ba ni/ a ra pa tsa na zhes pa'i sngags don no/ /kun tu bzang po ste/ rnam pa thams cad du sems can thams cad kyi mngon par 'dod pa'i don bzang po mdzad pa'i phyir dang / rnam pa kun tu dge ba byang chub kyi sems rdo rje'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ blo gros bzang po ste/ bdag dang gzhan gyi phan pa thams cad bskyed cing / dri ma med pas mdzes pa'i blo gros mnga' ba'i phyir/

sa'i snying po ste/ sa bzhin du mi 'gyur bar sems can thams cad kyi bde legs kyi gnas dang rgyur gyur pa'i phyir/ 'gro ba 'dzin pa ste/ 'gro ba ma lus pa 'dzin cing 'tsho bar byed pa'i rten tshogs gnyis kyi bdag nyid can yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po che ste/ garba zhes pa'i sgra ni skyed pa la yang yod de/ mnga' ba bzhin no/ /zhes pa ltar/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skye gnas chen po byang chub kyi sems kyi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ sprul pa'i 'khor lo sna tshogs 'chang ba ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpag tu med pa'i sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin par mdzad pa'i phyir dang / rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha rnams kyi sprul pa 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin mchog /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin 'dzin/ /skye med chos te sna tshogs don/ /chos kun ngo bo nyid 'chang ba/ /shes rab chen pos skad cig la/ /chos kun khong du chud pa 'chang / /chos kun mngon par rtogs pa ste/ thub pa blo mchog 'byung po'i mtha'/ /mi g.yo rab tu dang ba'i bdag /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub 'chang / /sangs rgyas kun gyi mngon sum pa/ /ye shes me lce 'od rab gsal/ /zhes pa la/ dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin mchog ste/ dngos po thams cad kyi rang bzhin skye med stong pa dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin 'dzin te/ chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin de rtag tu mi 'bral bar 'chang ba'i phyir/ skye med chos te sna tshogs don/ /zhes bya ste/ don dam par skye ba med pa'i chos gang dang ldan pa de nyid kun rdzob tu 'gro ba ma lus pa la phan 'dogs pa'i don sna tshogs byed pa'i phyir/ chos kun ngo bo nyid 'chang ba ste/ phung po la sogs pa nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar gyi ngo bo nyid de/

de bzhin nyid dang yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / chos kyi dbyings zhes bya ba de dag yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'dzin pa'i phyir/ sngags don las/ 'di'i shes byed du/ de ltar yang / ye shes zhabs kyis gsungs pa/ yang dag byang chu sems bskyed dang / byams pa chen po rab sbyor te/ /chos rnams thams cad bdag med ces/ /de ltar shes nas rnam par grol/ /zhes drangs so/ /shes rab chen pos skad cig la/ chos kun khong du chud par 'chang ba ste/ shes bya thams cad thugs su chud pa'i ngo bo nyid kyi shes rab kyis dus skad cig ma gcig la chos thams cad rab tu rtogs shing 'dzin pa'i phyir/ chos kun mngon par rtogs pa ste/ 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas dang / zag bcas dang / zag med dang / 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbye bas phye ba'i/ chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du thugs su chud pa'i phyir/ thub pa blo mchog ste/ sku gsung thugs thub pa dang ldan zhing chos thams cad thugs su chud pa'i blo mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir/ 'byung po'i mtha' ste/ 'gro ba rnams kyi mthar thug pa mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir/ mi g.yo ba ste/ gnas ngan len dang rnam rtog thams cad spangs pas/ ting nge 'dzin brtan zhing mi 'gyur bar gnas pa'i phyir/ rab du dang ba'i bdag ste/ ma rig pa dang 'dod chags la sogs pa'i rnyog pa thams cad dang bral bas/ dri ma med pa'i sku'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub 'chang ba ste/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i bdag nyid zad pa dang / mi skye ba'i ye shes mthar thug pa'i byang chub 'dzin par mdzad pa'i phyir/ de bas na sangs rgyas kun gyi mngon sum pa ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub kyi ngo bo nyid rang rig pa'i bdag nyid du rtogs pa'i phyir/ ye shes me lce 'od rab gsal ba ste/ sgrib pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba'i ye shes me lce dang 'dra ba'i 'od kyis shes bya thams cad snang bar byed pa'i bdag nyid can yin pa'i phyir/

༈ bzhi pa rin 'byung gi sgo nas mnyam nyid ye shes la bstod pa la gsum/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'dod pa'i don sgrub dam pa ste/ /ngan song thams cad rnam sbyong ba/ /mgon po sems can kun gyi mchog /sems can thams cad rab grol byed/ /nyon mongs g.yul du gcig dpa' ba/ /mi shes dgra yi dregs pa 'joms/ /blo ldan sgeg 'chang dpal dang ldan/ /brtan po mi sdug gzugs 'chang ba/ /zhes pa la/ 'dod pa'i don sgrub dam pa ste/ 'dod don gyi gtso bo rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid dang / zhar byung mtho ris dang / longs spyod dang / dbang phyug dang / rig 'dzin la sogs pa thams cad rdzogs par stsol ba'i phul du byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ ngan song thams cad rnam sbyong ba ste/ ngan song gsum du 'jug pa'i las kyi gnyen por gyur pa/ thar pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos rnams ston par mdzad pa'i phyir de nyid kyis na/ mgon po sems can kun gyi mchog ste/ gzhan don bya ba la mngon par brtson pas/ mgon med pa'i sems can rnams kyi mgon dam par gyur pa'i phyir/ sems can thams cad rab grol byed pa ste/ gdul bya rnams kyi mos pa dang / dbang po sogs dang 'tsham par rnam grol gyi lam bstan pa'i sgo nas nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba thams cad las grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs g.yul du gcig dpa' ba ste/ bdag tu zhen pa'i rtsa ba can gyi chags sogs nyon mongs pa dang / lhan cig g.yul sprod pa na/ zla med par dpa' ba yin pa'i phyir/ mi shes dgra yi dregs pa 'joms pa ste/ bden pa sogs la phyin ci log tu 'jug pa/ mi shes pa'am gti mug ni/ dge ba'i phyogs kyi bar chad byed pas dgra yin la/ de'i dregs pa ni bdag nyid gcig pus sems can ma lus pa rnams mi shes pa'i zhags pas bcings nas/ ngan song gsum du ltung bar bya'o/ /zhes brnyas pa dang bcas pa ste/ de nyid nges par bcom pa'i phyir/

blo ldan sgeg 'chang dpal dang ldan pa ste/ dri ma med pa'i shes rab kyi ngo bor gyur kyang / sgeg pa la sogs pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'i gzugs sna tshogs pas/ gdul bya'i skye bo rnams kyi don thams cad rdzogs par mdzad pa'i phyir/ 'di la 'grel chen du/ dpal ldan blo dang sgeg pa 'chang / zhes dang / sngags don las/ dpal ldan dhīḥste sgeg 'chang ba/ /zhes kyang bshad mod/ tshig snga ma nyid rigs par dgag sgrub dang bcas te 'grel chen nyid las gsungs so/ /brtan po mi sdug gzugs 'chang ba ste/ bdud la sogs pa'i dgra thams cad 'joms pa la dpa' zhing / gang gis kyang mi 'jigs par brtan pa'i gzugs dang / shin tu drag cing mi bzad par 'jigs su rung ba'i khro bo'i gzugs 'dzin pa'i phyir/ ༈ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ gzhan don sgrub pa'i lam dang / 'bras bu mngon du byed tshul lo/ /dang po la bzhi/ ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul/ mdzad pa po'i rnam pa/ lam rang gi ngo bo lam gyi nges par 'byung tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ lag pa brgya po kun bskyod cing / /gom pa'i stabs kyis gar byed pa/ /dpal ldan lag pa brgyas gang la/ /nam mkha' khyab par gar byed pa/ /sa yi dkyil 'khor gzhi yi khyon/ /rkang pa ya gcig mthil gyis gnon/ /rkang mtheb sen mo'i khyon gyi kyang / /tshangs pa'i yul sa rtse nas gnon/ /don gcig gnyis med chos kyi don/ /dam pa'i don ni 'jig pa med/ /rnam rig sna tshogs gzugs don can/ /sems dang rnam shes rgyud dang ldan/ /dngos don ma lus rnams la dga'/ /stong pa nyid dga' 'dod chags blo/ /srid pa'i 'dod chags sogs spangs pa/ /srid gsum dga' ba chen po ste/ /zhes pa ste/ sgeg pa dang dpa' ba la sogs pa gar gyi bye brag gis/ phyag brgya dang / zhabs brgya la sogs pas nam mkha'i khams thams can khyab cing / sgyu 'phrul chen po'i gar gyi dbang phyug tu gyur pa yang bcom ldan 'das nyid do zhes ston pa ni/

lag pa brgya po kun bskyod cing / /ces te/ sems can sdug bsngal ba rnams la phyag ngar brgyas sdug bsngal sel bar byed cing / de'i ched du bskyod pa'i phyir/ gom pa'i stabs kyis/ gar byed pa ste/ rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul rnams kyis mgu bar mdzad nas/ mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la 'jog pa'i phyir du/ g.yas brkyang dang / g.yon brkyang la sogs pa'i gar du ma mdzad pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' la spyod bya'i gar bstan pa'i phyir du/ dpal ldan lag pa brgyas gang la/ /nam mkha' khyab par gar byed pa zhes te/ tshogs gnyis kyi dpal dang ldan pa'i lag pa brgyas yul gang la phan par gzigs pa ni/ nam mkha' khyab par bskyod cing / yongs su bskor ba'i tshul gyis sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa'i gar gyi dbang phyug dam pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gar gyi khyad par ston pa'i phyir du/ sa yi dkyil 'khor gzhi yi khyon/ /rkang pa ya gcig mthil gyis gnon/ /zhes te/ sa chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi'i khyon nam ngos thams cad/ zhabs ya gcig gi mthil gyis kyang gnon cing khyab par mdzad pa'i phyir/ rkang mtheb sen mo'i khyon gyis kyang / tshangs pa'i yul sa rtse nas gnon pa ste/ zhabs de'i mthe bo'i sen mo tsam gyis kyang / tshangs pa'i yul sa ste/ srid pa'i rtse mo'i steng na nam mkha'i mthar thug pa'i gzugs su/ mu stegs pa rnams kyis yongs su btags pa ste/ de'i steng nas gnon par mdzad pa'i phyir/ zhes 'grel chen du 'chad la/ don du na/ rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dul ba'i skye bo la phan pa'i phyir du/ rkang mtheb kyi sen mo tsam gyis kyang / tshangs pa'i yul gyi rtse mo man chad khyab par ston pa'i phyir/ de dag kyang gdul bya'i dbang gis bstan pa tsam yin gyi/ nges pa'i don du na/ don gcig gnyis med chos kyi don/ /dam pa'i don ni 'jig pa med/ /ces te/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa nyid du ro gcig cing /

gzung 'dzin gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi chos kyi don tsam yin pa'i phyir dang / gnas lugs dam pa'i don de ni/ nam mkha' dang 'dra bar 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ de ltar na yang / rnam rig sna tshogs gzugs don can te/ sngon goms pa'i thugs rje dang smon lam gyi mthus rnam rig sna tshogs pa'i gzugs kyi snang bas 'gro ba rnams kyi don mdzad pa'i phyir/ sems dang rnam shes rgyud dang ldan pa ste/ rtog bral ye shes kyi sems dang / rtogs bcas rnam par shes pa'i mtshan nyid can te/ de gnyis kyi rgyud dam rgyun rab tu dang ba me long gi ngos dang 'dra ba la skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i snang ba bskyed par mdzad pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ dngos don ma lus rnams la dga' ba ste/ dngos po la mngon par zhen pa'i skye bo rnams kyi don du/ rang dang spyi'i tshul gyis dngos po rnams la skye ba dang gnas pa la sogs pa'i/ brda dang tha snyad rnams sbyor bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ stong pa nyid la dga' ba ste/ chos thams cad kyi chos nyid de bzhin nyid las/ don dam par mngon par zhen pa med pa'i tshul gyis spro ba dang ldan pa'i phyir/ des na 'dod chags blo ste/ de ltar de bzhin nyid la zhen pa med pa'i tshul gyis zhen pa de'i phyir/ srid pa'i 'dod chags sogs spangs pa ste/ gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i khams gnyis la mngon par zhen pa ni srid pa'i 'dod chags te de las 'das pa'i phyir dang / sogs pa'i sgras 'dod pa'i 'dod chags ma lus pa spangs pa'i phyir/ srid gsum dga' ba chen po ste/ de ltar chos nyid thugs su chud pas srid pa gsum la 'dod chags dang bral du zin kyang / thugs rje chen pos srid pa gsum gyi sems can rnams 'don par bya ba'i thabs la dgyes pa chen po dang ldan pa'i phyir/ ༈ gnyis pa mdzad pa po'i rnam pa ni/ sprin dkar dag pa bzhin du dkar/ /'od bzang ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od/ /nyi ma 'char ka'i dkyil ltar mdzes/

/sen mo'i 'od ni shas cher dmar/ /cod pan bzang po mthon ka'i rtse/ /skra mchog mthon ka chen po can/ /nor bu chen po 'od chags dpal/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rgyan dang ldan/ /zhes pa la/ sprin dkar dag pa bzhin du dkar ba ste/ chu 'dzin dkar po kha dog gzhan dang ma 'dres pas dag pa bzhin du/ dri ma dang bral ba'i shes rab kyi rang bzhin can gyi sku dang ldan pa'i phyir/ 'od bzang ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od dang ldan pa ste/ dang zhes bsil la 'gro ba rnams tshim par byed pa'i 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa mnga' ba'i phyir dang / shes rab kyi 'od zer 'phro bas rnam par mdzes pa'i phyir/ nyi ma 'char ka'i dkyil ltar mdzes pa ste/ thugs rje chen pos sems can la chags pa'i mdangs kyis phyi rol tu 'od dmar pos mdzes pa'i phyir/ sen mo'i 'od ni shas cher dmar ba ste/ rgyu mtshan snga ma de nyid kyis na 'od dmar po dang ldan pa'i sen mo mnga' ba'i phyir/ cod pan bzang po mthon ka'i rtse mo can te/ rin po che mthon ka'i rtse'am mchog gi kha dog ltar sngo zhing mdzes pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa'i phyir/ skra mchog mthon ka chen po can te/ nor bu mthon ka chen po ltar shin tu sngo ba'i skra'i mchog 'chang ba'i phyir/ de yang mthon ka ni cung zad sngo ba/ mthon ka chen po ni shin tu sngo ba'o/ /nor bu chen po 'od chags dpal te/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po ltar 'gro ba ma lus pa'i mngon par 'dod pa'i don mtha' dag rdzogs par mdzad pa'i phyir dang / sprul pa'i 'od zer rnams kyis mdzes pa'i dpal dang ldan pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa ste/ rin po che la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad zil gyis gnon par byed pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i rgyan gyis shin tu legs par brgyan pa'i phyir/ ༈ gsum pa lam rang gi ngo bo ni/ 'jig rten khams brgya kun bskyod pa/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i stobs chen ldan/

/de nyid dran pa chen po 'chang / /dran pa bzhi po'i ting 'dzin rgyal/ /byang chub yan lag me tog spos/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan mtsho/ /lam gyi yan lag brgyad tshul rig /yang dag sangs rgyas lam rig pa/ /sems can kun la shas cher chags/ /nam mkha' lta bur chags pa med/ /sems can kun gyi yid la 'jug /sems can kun gyi yid ltar mgyogs/ /sems can kun gyi dbang don shes/ /sems can kun gyi yid 'phrog pa/ /phung po lnga don de nyid shes/ /rnam dag phung po lnga 'chang ba/ /zhes pa la/ 'jig rten khams brgya kun bskyod pa/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i stobs chen ldan/ /zhes te/ de la rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni 'dun pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / sems dang / dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'o/ /de yang yul la mngon du phyogs pa'i 'dun pas ni/ chos de dag mngon par bsgrub bo/ /de la bzhugs pa'i brtson 'grus kyis ni rdzogs par byed do/ /ngo bo la rtog par byed pa'i sems kyis ni 'jog par byed do/ /khyad par la mkhas pa'i dpyod pas ni/ de dag rnam par 'byed par byed do/ /de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i stobs chen po dang ldan pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa bskyod cing gnon par mdzad pa'i phyir/ 'dir 'jig rten gyi khams brgya zhes pa ni nye bar mtshon pa tsam ste/ gzhan du na sa bcu pa'i mdo las rgya cher gsungs pa ltar/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir/ de nyid dran pa chen po 'chang ba ste/ yul bcu la dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'i dran pa chen po de dag dang ldan pa'i phyir/ bcu po de yang gang zhe na/ lus dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang / tshor ba/ sems/ chos/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dang / de bzhin du chos/ dge 'dun/ tshul khrims/ gtong ba/ lha rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa'o/ /dran pa bzhi po ting 'dzin rgyal te/ stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang /

smon pa med pa dang / rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba dran pa'i tshul can/ dpa' bar 'gro ba la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin brgya stong gi bdag por gyur pa'i phyir/ byang chub yan lag me tog spos te/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun po nyid/ sgom lam 'bras bu'i rgyur gyur pa'i me tog yin la/ de rnams kyi spos sam dri 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa khyab pa'i yod tan dang / ye shes kyi rang bzhin dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan mtsho ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la sogs pa rnams shin tu rgya che zhing / yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ lam gyi yan lag brgyad tshul rig pa ste/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / thun mongs ma yin pa'i tshul gyis mkhyen pa'i phyir/ de nyid kyis na/ yang dag sangs rgyas lam rig pa ste/ sangs rgyas kyi lam chos kyi dbyings gzhan gyis bstan pa la mi ltos par/ rang nyid kyis phyin ci ma log par thugs su chud pa'i phyir/ sems can kun la shas cher chags pa ste/ sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la 'jug pa'i thugs rje chen po'i ngo bo nyid du gyur pa'i phyir/ nam mkha' lta bur chags pa med pa ste/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par thugs su chud pa/ dri ma med pa'i sher phyin gyi ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir/ sems can kun gyi yid la 'jug pa ste/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi chos nyid mnyam pa nyid thugs su chud pa'i phyir/ sems can kun gyi yid ltar mgyogs pa ste/ 'dul ba'i dus las mi 'da' bar cig char du sems kyi rjes su 'gro bas/ chos kyi de kho na nyid snang bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ sems can kun gyi dbang don shes pa ste/ dad sogs kyi dbang po rab 'bring tha ma mkhyen nas de dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos ston pa'i phyir/

sems can kun gyi yid 'phrog pa ste/ sems can thams cad dang rjes su mthun pa'i sku yid 'phrog pa ston par mdzad pa'i phyir/ phung po lnga don de nyid shes pa ste/ gzugs sogs kyi phung po rnams tha snyad sgyu ma lta bu dang / don dam par gzod ma nas ma skyes pa'i/ de kho na nyid legs par mkhyen pa'i phyir/ rnam dag phung po lnga 'chang ba ste/ tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po ste/ zag pa med pa'i phung po lnga'i ngo bo nyid rtag tu 'dzin pa'i phyir/ ༈ bzhi pa lam gyis nges par 'byung ba'i tshul ni/ nges 'byung kun gyi mtha' la gnas/ /nges par 'byung ba kun la mkhas/ /nges 'byung kun gyi lam la gnas/ /nges par 'byung ba kun ston pa/ /yan lag bcu gnyis srid rtsa bton/ /dag pa rnam pa bcu gnyis 'chang / /bden bzhi'i tshul gyi rnam pa can/ /shes pa brgyad po rtogs pa 'chang / /bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan/ /de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig /rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa/ /rnam par sangs rgyas kun rig mchog /zhes pa la/ nges 'byung kun gyi mtha' la gnas pa ste/ theg pa gsum gyi nges par 'byung ba'i mthar thug pa la gzhan 'jog cing rang nyid bzhugs pa'i phyir/ nges par 'byung ba kun la mkhas pa ste/ de thams cad kyi rang gi ngo bo dang / khyad par ji lta ba bzhin thugs su chud pa'i phyir/ nges 'byung kun gyi lam la gnas pa ste/ de thams cad la rang nyid zhugs pa'i tshul gyis gnas 'jug par mdzad pa'i phyir/ nges par 'byung ba kun ston pa ste/ mthar thug theg pa gcig gis lam ston par mdzad kyang gnas skabs gdul bya'i ngor/ theg pa gsum gyi nges par 'byung ba ston pa'i phyir/ sngags don las/ nges 'byung kun gyi mtha' la gnas/ zhes sogs rkang pa bzhi rim pa ltar 'jig rten pa dang / nyan thos dang / rang rgyal dang / theg chen gyi myang 'das la sbyar nas 'chad do/

/yan lag bcu gnyis srid rtsa bton pa ste/ ma rig pa la sogs pa rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i yan lag bcu gnyis kyi mtshan nyid can gyi srid pa'i rtsa ba bdag 'dzin drung phyung ba'i phyir/ dag pa rnam pa bcu gnyis 'chang ba ste/ thabs dang shes rab kyi stobs kyis shin tu rnam par dag pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi/ srid pa'i yan lag 'dzin pa'i phyir dang / gzung 'dzin gyis dben pa'i skye mched bcu gnyis 'chang ba'i phyir/ bden bzhi'i tshul gyi rnam pa can te/ sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung dang / 'gog pa dang lam gyi mtshan nyid can/ bden pa bzhi'i tshul lam/ lam gyi rnam pa sna tshogs ston par mdzad pa'i phyir/ shes pa brgyad po rtogs pa 'chang ba ste/ bden pa bzhi po re re la yang / chos shes pa dang / rjes su shes pa zhes bya ba'i shes pa brgyad po theg pa gsum gyis bsdus pa rnams/ gdul bya dang rjes su mthun par thugs su chud cing 'dzin par mdzad pa'i phyir/ bden don rnam pa bcu gnyis ldan pa ste/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi rnam pas bden pa la 'jug pa'i ye shes kyis skye mched bcu gnyis rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa'i phyir dang / sa bcu gnyis kyi mthar thug pa'i bden pa'i dgos pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig pa ste/ sher phyin las gsungs pa ltar/ nang stong pa nyid la sogs pa stong pa nyid bcu drug gi de kho na nyid mkhyen pa'i phyir/ rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa ste/ snga ma de dag las gzhan stong pa nyid bzhi dang bcas pa'i stong pa nyid nyi shu'i rnam pa thugs su chud pa'i phyir/ bzhi po de yang mdo las/ rab 'byor gzhan yang dngos po ni dngos pos stong ngo / /dngos po med pa ni dngos po med pas stong ngo / /rang bzhin ni rang bzhin gyis stong ngo / /gzhan gyi dngos po ni gzhan gyi dngos pos stong ngo / /zhes pa'o/ /rnam par sangs rgyas kun rig mchog ste/ rnam pa sna tshogs pas byang chub cing thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga' bas srid zhi thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir/

༈ gnyis pa 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i tshul la gsum/ 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo ni/ gzhan don lhun grub tu 'byung tshul/ de dag gi 'thad pa bstan pa'o/ ༈ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa'i sku/ /bye ba dpag med 'gyed pa po/ /skad cig thams cad mngon par rtogs/ /sems kyi skad cig don kun rig /theg pa sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis/ /'gro ba'i don la rtogs pa po/ /theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ /nyon mongs khams rnams dag pa'i bdag /las kyi khams rnams zad byed pa/ /chu bo rgya mtsho kun las brgal/ /sbyor ba'i dgon pa las byung ba/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i kun nyon mongs/ /bag chags bcas pa gtan spangs pa/ /zhes pa la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa'i sku/ /bye ba dpag med 'gyed pa po ste/ ji skad bshad pa'i tshul gyis lam mthar phyin pa na/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa dpag tu med pa'i phrin las rnams kyis 'jigs rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa'i sems can rnams kyi don cig char du mdzad pa'i phyir/ skad cig thams cad mngon par rtogs pa ste/ shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug la sogs pa sems kyi skad cig gi bye brag thams cad thugs su chud pa'i phyir/ sems kyi skad cig don kun rig pa ste/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi skad cig gi don rang bzhin gyi skye ba med pa ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pa'i phyir/ theg pa sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis/ /'gro ba'i don la rtogs pa po ste/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i theg pa sna tshogs kyi thabs tshul lam/ lam bstan pas/ 'gro ba'i don mngon mtho dang nges legs thams cad rdzogs par mdzad pa'i phyir/ theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas pa ste/ gnas skabs gdul bya'i bsam pa'i bye brag gi dbang du mdzad nas/ theg pa gsum gyi lam gyis nges par 'byung ba'i tshul gsungs la/

mtha' thug theg pa chen po gcig tu zad cing / 'bras bu yang sangs rgyas kho nar gnas pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs khams rnams dag pa'i bdag ste/ chos thams cad bdag med par rtogs pas nyon mongs pa rnams kyi khams sam rgyu ma lus pa drung phyung ba'i tshul gyis dag pa'i bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir/ las kyi khams rnams zad byed pa ste/ khams gsum gyis bsdus pa'i las kun slong dang bcas pa yang / skye ba med pa'i chos can du rtogs shing ston pa'i phyir/ chu bo rgya mtsho kun las brgal ba ste/ 'dod pa'i chu bo dang / srid pa'i chu bo dang / lta ba'i chu bo dang / ma rig pa'i chu bo ste/ bzhi po de dag ni/ sems can rnams kyi legs pa'i tshogs 'phrog pas chu bo dang / brgal bar dka' bas rgya mtsho ste/ de thams cad las yang dag par brgal zhing / slar mi ldog pa'i tshul gyis spangs pa'i phyir/ sbyor ba'i dgon pa las byung ba ste/ 'dod pa'i sbyor ba dang / srid pa'i sbyor ba dang / lta ba'i sbyor ba dang / ma rig pa'i sbyor ba rnams ni/ khams dang / 'gro ba dang / skye gnas dang / sa rnams su sbyor bas sbyor ba/ de nyid shin tu 'jigs su rung bas dgon pa ste/ de thams cad las byung zhing nges par 'thon pa'i phyir ro/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i kun nyon mongs/ /bag chags bcas pa gtan spangs pa ste/ 'dod chags la sogs pa rtsa ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / khro ba la sogs pa nye ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad/ bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus pa rnam pa thams cad du spangs pa'i phyir/ ༈ gnyis pa gzhan don lhun grub tu 'byung tshul ni/ snying rje chen po shes rab thabs/ /don yod 'gro ba'i don byed pa/ /'du shes kun gyi don spangs shing / /rnam shes don ni 'gag par byed/ /sems can kun gyi yul dang ldan/ /sems can kun gyi yid rig pa/ /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas/ /de dag sems dang mthun par 'jug /sems can kun yid tshim par byed/

/sems can kun gyi yid dga' ba/ /zhes pa la/ snying rje chen po shes rab thabs/ /don yod 'gro ba'i don byed pa ste/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang / spros pa dang bral ba'i mkhyen rab dang / gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas pa rnams kyis/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don yod cing / 'gro ba'i don mtho ris dang byang grol gyi mtshan nyid can/ thams cad rdzogs par mdzad pa'i phyir/ 'du shes kun gyi don spangs pa ste/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'du shes thams cad dang / de rnams kyi don te dgos par dmigs pa gang yin pa rnams gnas lugs rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis spangs shing spong bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ rnam shes don ni 'gag par byed pa ste/ gzugs sogs kyi yul rnam par rig pa ni rnam shes dang / de'i don ni des gzung bar bya ba'i yul te/ de dag skye ba med par rtogs pas zag pa dang bcas pa'i yul dang / mngon zhen thams cad spong bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ sems can kun yid yul dang ldan pa ste/ gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa rnam par spangs su zin kyang / sems can thams cad kyi yid dang de'i spyod yul dang bcas pa la dmigs nas skal ba dang ldan pa dang / mi ldan pa sogs thugs su chud pa'i phyir/ sems can kun gyi yid rig pa ste/ dbang po tha dad pa'i sems can rnams kyi sems kyi bye brag ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pa'i phyir/ sngags don las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rig pa/ /zhes bton nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rig pa'i phyir/ zhes 'chad do/ /sems can kun gyi yid la gnas pa ste/ thugs rje chen pos sems can thams cad kyi yid dang sems la dmigs nas smin grol gyi dus la bab pa dang / ma bab pa sogs gzigs par mdzad pa'i phyir/ des na de dag sems dang mthun par 'jug pa ste/ de dag gi skal ba dang / bsam pa dang mthun par snang ba bskyed cing 'dod don rdzogs par mdzad pa'i phyir/

sems can kun yid tshim par byed pa ste/ nye ring med pa sems can thams cad kyang zag pa med pa'i ye shes nyid la sbyor ba'i tshul gyis tshim zhing mgu bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ des na sems can kun gyi yid dga' ba ste/ sems can thams cad kyi zag pa med pa'i mchog tu dga' ba chen po dang ldan par mdzad pa'i phyir/ ༈ gsum pa de dag gi 'thad pa bstan pa ni/ grub pa'i mthar phyin 'khrul pa med/ /nor ba thams cad rnam par spangs/ /don gsum the tshom med pa'i blo/ /kun don yon tan gsum gyi bdag /phung po lnga don dus gsum du/ /skad cig thams cad bye brag phyed/ /skad cig gcig gi rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin 'chang / /zhes pa la/ grub pa'i mthar phyin 'khrul ba med pa ste/ grub pa'i mtha' dang / man ngag thams cad kyi mthar thug pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas/ 'khrul ba'i drwa ba thams cad spangs pa'i phyir/ des na nor ba thams cad rnam par spangs pa ste/ chos thams can ji lta ba bzhin phyin ci ma log par mkhyen pa'i phyir/ don gsum the tshom med pa'i blo dang ldan pa ste/ spang bar bya ba dang / blang bar bya ba dang / btang snyoms su bzhag par bya ba'i chos gsum ji lta ba bzhin du ston pa la/ bslu ba med pa'i mkhyen pa dri ma med pa mnga' ba'i phyir/ kun don yon tan gsum gyi bdag ste/ skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du gdul bya thams cad kyi phan pa dang / bde ba'i don du 'gyur ba'i phyir dang / yon tan gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i ngo bo nyid du ston pa'i phyir/ de yang yon tan gsum ni/ snying stobs dang / rdul dang / mun pa ste/ 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug gi bdag nyid yin la/ de dag gis 'dul ba'i sems can rnams kyi don du de'i rnam par ston pa yin gyi/ grangs can gyis btags pa/ bems po'i ngo bor gyur pa'i yon tan ni ma yin te/ de ni tshad ma'i stobs kyis khegs pa'i phyir/

de bzhin du phung po lnga don dus gsum du ston pa ste/ gzugs sogs kyi phung po lnga'i don dus gsum gyis bsdus pa/ de dang der so sor snang ba bskyed par mdzad pa'i phyir/ skad cig thams cad bye brag phyed pa ste/ skad cig ma bcu drug la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i lam la sogs pa so sor rtogs shing ston par mdzad pa'i phyir/ de ltar sna tshogs su ston kyang / rang gi ngo bo ni/ skad cig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas pa ste/ skad cig ma gcig kho na la zad pa dang mi skye ba shes pa'i ye shes mthar thug pa mngon du mdzad pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin 'chang ba ste/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin nam/ mtshan nyid chos kyi sku'i bdag nyid kyis rtag tu gnas pa'i phyir ro/ ༈ /gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ lus med lus te lus kyi mchog /lus kyi mtha' ni rtogs pa po/ /gzugs rnams sna tshogs kun tu ston/ /nor bu chen po rin chen tog /ces te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid kyi skus sems can thams cad kyi don thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mdzad pa la/ rang dbang du gyur cing gzugs thams cad las lhag pa'i skur sprul pas gzugs kyi mngon par rlom pa'i sems can rnams kyi dregs pa bsal nas/ don mdzad pa la mkhas par bstan pa'i phyir du/ lus med lus te lus kyi mchog /ces gsungs te/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin nyid yin pas bems pos bsdus pa'i lus med cing / longs sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i tshul gyis lha la sogs pa thams cad las ches mchog tu gyur pa'i gzugs kyi sku ston pa'i phyir/ lus kyi mtha' ni rtogs pa po ste/ gzugs de yang gdul bya'i dbang gis mtha' yas shing grangs med par sprul zhing 'phro bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ gzugs rnams sna tshogs kun tu ston pa ste/ lha la sogs pa gang dang gang gis 'dul ba rnams la/ de dang de'i gzugs ma lus pa rnams kun tu ston pa'i phyir/

des na bcom ldan 'jam dpal ni/ nor bu chen po te/ nyes pa thams cad dang bral zhing / yon tan thams cad kyi 'od zer gyi snang ba dang ldan pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu chen po mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes nyid yin pa'i phyir/ rin chen tog ste/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin mthar phyin pas sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i rin po ches mtshan pa'i phyir dang / khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang byin pa'i tog gam phyag rgya nyid yin pa'i phyir/ ༈ lnga pa don grub kyi sgo nas bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la bstod pa la gsum/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ don bsdu ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rtogs bya ba/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bla na med/ /gsangs sngags las byung yi ge med/ /gsang sngags chen po rigs gsum pa/ /zhes pa la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rtogs bya ba ste/ chos kyi sku'i bdag nyid can yin pas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs su chud par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas byang chub bla na med pa ste/ chos kyi sku de nyid sangs rgyas kyi byang chub yin la/ de nyid byang chub thams cad kyi mthar thug pa bla na med pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsang sngags las byung yi ge med pa ste/ mtshan rtogs las skyob par byed pas stong pa nyid kyi ye shes las yang dag par byung ba'i phyir dang / yi ge la sogs pa brjod pa dang / brjod pa'i mtshan nyid dang bral ba chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ gsang sngags las byung yi ge med pa ste/ mtshan rtog las skyob par byed pas stong pa nyid kyi ye shes las yang dag par byung ba'i phyir dang / yi ge la sogs pa brjod pa dang / brjod bya'i mtshan nyid dang bral ba chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ gsang sngags chen po rigs gsum pa ste/ rgyu che ba dang 'bras bu che ba'i bdag nyid kyi gsang sngags de ni/

sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi ngo bos/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang / padma dang / rdo rje'i rigs rnam pa gsum du gnas pa'i phyir/ de la rgyu che ba ni/ thams cad du khyab pa'i thugs rje chen po dang / stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin las byung ba'i phyir ro/ /'bras bu che ba ni/ sems can ma lus pa'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas nyid 'bras bu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rgyas par bshad par gnyis/ las kyi rnam par bzhag pa/ 'bras bu'i rnam par bzhag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gsang sngags don kun skyed pa po/ /thig le chen po yi ge med/ /stong pa chen po yi ge lnga/ /thig le stong pa yi ge brgya/ /rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med/ /bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can/ /yan lag med pa'i rtsis las 'das/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo can/ /bsam gtan yan lag kun shes shing / /ting 'dzin rig dang rgyud rig pa/ /zhes te/ don dam par yi ge sogs med kyang / tha snyad du gsang sngags kyi rigs rnams bskyed par mdzad pas/ bcom ldan 'das nyid rnam pa thams cad du thams cad kyi rgyu nyid du bstan pa'i phyir/ gsang sngags don kun skyed pa po/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang ma ni ye shes/ tra ni skyob pas na gsang sngags yin la/ de bdag dang gzhan gyi rgyud la rdzogs par mdzad pa'i phyir dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gsang sngags thams cad kyi don bskyed cing 'byin par mdzad pa'i phyir/ thig le chen po yi ge med pa ste/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir dang / de nyid yi ge dang / sgra dang / tha snyad thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir/ stong pa chen po ste/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid bcu drug la sogs pa'i ngo bo nyid du gyur pa'i phyir/ de nyid yi ge lnga ste/ a ra pa tsa na'i sngags kyi bdag nyid can du gyur pa'i phyir/ gal te de ltar na/ yi ge med pa dang /

yi ge lnga'i bdag nyid du gyur pas 'gal lo snyan na/ ma yin te/ yi ge lnga'i gsang sngags nyid stong chen yi ge med pa'i don yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang yi ge a ni chos thams cad skye ba med pa'o/ /yi ge ra ni skye ba med pas 'dod chags la sogs pa'i rdul dang bral ba'o/ /yi ge pa ni don dam pa nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yi ge tsa ni 'phel ba dang / 'grib pa dang bral ba'o/ /des na yi ge na ni chos thams cad dngos po med pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /thig le stong pa yi ge brgya zhes bya ste/ thig le nyid stong pa yin pa'i tshul bshad zin pa'i phyir dang / stong pa de'i ngo bo nyid kyi yi ge brgya ba'i gsang sngags kyi tshul gyis phyag rgya thams cad brtan par byed cing / dam tshig nyams pa las bslang ba dang / bdag srung ba la sogs pa'i bya ba thams cad rdzogs par byed pa'i phyir/ de la yi ge brgya pa'i gsang sngags ni/ oṃ badzra tiṣṭha sa ma ya/ ma nu pa la ya/ badzra tiṣṭha twe no pa tiṣṭha/ ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su toṣyo me bha wa/ sha shwatwa me bha wa/ a nu rag to me bha wa/ su poṣyo me bha wa/ hri da ya me a dhi tiṣṭha/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsittaṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wan ma me muñtsa/ triṇḍi bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes pa'o/ /sngags don las/ thig le stong pa yi ge drug /ces bton nas/ oṃ wa ki shwa ri muṃḥ zhes pa'i yi ge drug gi bdag nyid kyi phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med pa ste/ de ltar mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku la sogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs su snang ba'i shes pa bskyed pa'i phyir dang / chos kyi sku'i ngo bo nyid kyi phyir/ de dag mi 'gal ba'i tshul ni bshad zin to/ /de nyid gsang sngags kyi sku'i sbyor bas kyang bzhugs so zhes bstan pa ni/ bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can te/ cha bcu drug gi phyed dang /

de'i phyed kyi zla ba la thig le'i rnam pa 'chang bar mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /don ni zla ba phyed pa'i steng du thig le phyed pa'i sgra'i tshul gyis sngags thams cad la dbang sgyur bar mdzad/ zhes pa'o/ /yan lag med pa'i rtsis las 'das pa ste/ grangs kyi mthar bgrang ba'i yan lag gam cha med pa'i phyir dang / de nyid kyis na 'di ni 'di dag tsam mo/ /zhes brtsi ba dang / nges par brtag pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo can te/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab kyi mtha'/ rtog pa gzhan thams cad dang bral ba'i ngo bo nyid 'dzin cing gnas pa'i phyir/ sngags don las/ bcu drug phyed phyed sogs tshig rkang gsum gyi don ni/ bla ma'i lung gis mi bshad de/ de yang sngags kyi sgo nas spyad pa spyod pa la slob ma rnams dus ring por bsnyen pa dang / bsam pa'i khyad par las man ngag snyan khung du brgyud pa rab tu bstan par bya'o/ /zhes bla mas gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes rgyu mtshan dang bcas pas ma bshad do/ /bsam gtan yan lag kun shes pa ste/ de ltar rtog pa thams cad las 'das kyang bsam gtan la mnga' brnyes pas gdul bya rnams la bsam gtan gyi yan lag gi rnam par dbye ba rab tu ston cing bskyed par mdzad pa'i phyir/ der ma zad/ ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi bre brag la shin tu mkhas par bstan pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin rig dang rgyud rig pa ste/ dpa' bar 'gro ba dang / rin chen phyag rgya la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams kyis rigs sam/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dam/ de dag la mchog tu 'brel ba'i ngo bo nyid ni rgyud de/ de rnams ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen pa'i phyir/ ༈ gnyis pa 'bras bu'i rnam par bzhag pa la gnyis/ sku'i rnam pa dang mdzad pa yod tan dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ting 'dzin lus can lus kyi mchog /longs spyod rdzogs sku kun gyi rgyal/ /sprul pa'i sku ste sku yi mchog /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rgyud 'chang ba/

/phyogs bcur sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed/ /ji bzhin 'gro ba'i don byed pa/ /lha dang lha dbang lha yi lha/ /lha yi dbang po lha min bdag /'chi med dbang po lha yi bla/ /'joms byed 'joms byed dbang phyug po/ /srid pa'i dgon pa las brgal ba/ /ston pa gcig pu 'gro ba'i bla/ /'jig rten phyogs bcur rab grags pa/ /chos kyi sbyin bdag chen po pa/ /byams pa'i go cha chas pa ste/ /snying rje yi ni ya lad bgos/ /shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs/ /zhes pa la/ ting 'dzin lus can lus kyi mchog ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rang bzhin ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ yid kyi lus can thams cad du thogs par med par 'jug pa'i lus kyi mchog gam gtso bo yin pa'i phyir/ longs spyod rdzogs sku kun gyi rgyal te/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i sku mdzes pa'i phyir/ sprul pa'i sku ste sku yi mchog ste/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sprul pa'i sku'i sgo nas kyang rnam pa thams cad du/ gzhan thams cad las phul du byung ba nyid kyi phyir/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i rgyud 'chang ba ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gdung rgyun mi gcod pa'i phyir du sprul pa de nyid rgyun chags pa 'chang ba'i phyir/ phyogs bcur sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed pa ste/ phul du byung ba'i khyad par de dang ldan pas phyogs thams can du sprul pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa spro ba'i phyir/ ji bzhin 'gro ba'i don byed pa ste/ skal ba ji bzhin du dam pa'i chos ston pa'i phyir/ de'i tshul yang / lha dang lha dbang lha yi lha ste/ skabs la lar ni lha'i rnam pa spyi dang / la lar ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / la lar ni lha'i lha tshangs pa dang / de bzhin du/ lha yi bdag po lha min bdag /'chi med dbang po lha yi bla/ /'joms byed 'joms byed dbang phyug po/ /zhes te/ la lar ni lha yi dbang po dang / la lar ni lha min bdag po thag zangs ris dang /

la lar ni 'chi med dbang po ste/ 'thab bral la sogs pa'i lha rnams kyi rgyal po dang / gzhan yang lha'i bla ma ste phur bu dang / 'joms byed de drag po'i 'khor rnams dang / 'joms byed dbang phyug ste/ drag po nyid la sogs pa sprul pa sna tshogs pas/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i phyir/ de yang chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sprul pa ni/ rnam pa bcur shes par bya ste/ 'di lta ste/ 'khor los sgyur bar sprul pa dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / sangs rgyas dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang / byang chub kyi snying po dang / 'khor lo chen por 'phrul pa ste/ bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi 'phrul pa chen por khong du chud par bya ste/ 'di dag thams cad ni gzhan gyi bsam pa las gyur par blta'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /srid pa'i dgon pa las brgal ba ste/ de ltar gzugs sna tshogs kyis gzhan don mdzad kyang / 'khor ba'i bag chags kyi nyes pa mi mnga' bas/ 'khor ba nyes pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa las brgal ba'i phyir/ ston pa gcig pu 'gro ba'i bla ma ste/ rdzu 'phrul dang cho 'phrul la sogs pas 'dun par mdzad nas/ theg pa chen po 'gro ba rnams la rjes su ston par mdzad pa'i phyir dang / 'gran pa'i zla gnyis pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /'jig rten phyogs bcur rab grags ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rnams na sbyin bdag chen po'i mchog tu ye shes dang ldan pa rnams kyis mkhyen pa'i tshul gyis rab tu grags pa'i phyir dang / de yang sbyin pa rnams kyi nang nas chos kyi sbyin pa ni phul du byung zhing / chos kyi sbyin bdag che ba po yin pa'i phyir/ byams pa'i go chas chas pa ste/ nyon mongs pa dang / mi shes pa dang / bdud kyi dgra rnams las rgyal ba'i phyir du/

sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar/ byams pa'i go cha dang / mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis 'bigs par dka' ba'i thugs rje chen po'i ya lad bgos pa'i phyir/ shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs pa ste/ phyi rol gyi mtshon cha'i bye brag dag gis ni nyon mongs pa dang / mi shes pa las rgyal bar gyur pa mi srid pas/ phul du byung ba'i mtshon cha dang ldan pa'i phyir/ zhes spyi tsam du bstan pa dang / sngags don las/ shes rab ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti'o/ /ral gri ni ye shes kyi ral gri'o/ /mda' ni sems phra mos 'bigs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /gzhu ni rdo rje'i gzhu'o/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa mdzad pa yon tan dang bcas pa la mdzad pa dngos ni/ nyon mongs mi shes g.yul ngo sel/ /dpa' bo 'dud dgra bdud thul ba/ /bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa sel bar byed/ /bdud kyi dpung rnams pham byed pa/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'dren/ /mchod 'os bstod 'os phyag gi gnas/ /rtag tu ri mor bya ba'i 'os/ /bkur 'os rjed par bya ba'i mchog /phyag byar 'os pa bla ma'i rab/ /'jig rten gsum po gom gcig bgrod/ /mkha' ltar mtha' med rnam par gnon/ /zhes pa la/ nyon mongs mi shes g.yul ngo sel ba ste/ nyon mongs pa'i dpung tshogs du mas bskor ba'i mi shes pa'i rgyal pos sems can rnams 'joms pa'i g.yul ngo rnam pa thams cad du 'joms par mdzad pa'i phyir/ dpa' bo bdud dgra 'dud thul ba ste/ lha'i bu la sogs pa bdud rnams kyi dgra yin cing / bdud de dag las rgyal bar mdzad pa'i phyir dang / de lta phyi nang gi dgra bo nges par bzlog pa'i stobs dang ldan pas dpa' bo yin pa'i phyir/ sngags don las/ bdud bzhi'i dgra bo de nyid 'dul ba ste/ rdo rje gdan la bzhugs nas mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams 'joms pa'i phyir/ zhes so/ /bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa sel bar byed pa ste/ phung po dang / nyon mongs pa dang /

'chi bdag dang / lha'i bu'i bdud rnams kyi 'jigs pa mtha' dag mthar 'byin par mdzad pa'i phyir/ bdud kyi dpung rnams pham byed pa ste/ byams pa dang / snying rje dang / shes rab rnams kyis/ nyon mongs pa dang / mi shes pa dang / bdud kyi sde rnams thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa'i phyir/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'dren pa ste/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi 'dren pa dam par gyur pa'i phyir/ de'i phyir rje btsun 'jam dpal de nyid ni/ mchod 'os bstod 'os phyag gi gnas/ /rtag tu ri mor bya ba'i 'os/ /bkur 'os rjed par bya ba'i 'os/ /phyag byar 'os pa bla ma'i rab/ /ces rnam grangs kyi sgo nas mtshan smos pa ste/ phul du byung ba'i yon tan gyis thams cad las khyad par du 'phags shing / bla na med pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ des na 'jig rten gsum po gom gcig bgrod pa ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don du 'jig rten gsum po thams cad du thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis gcig char gom pa gcig gis bgrod pa'i phyir/ mkha' ltar mtha' med rnam par gnon pa ste/ nam mkha' la mtha' med pa ltar/ sems can gyi don du 'jig rten mtha' med par rnam par gnon par mdzad pa'i phyir/ de'i yon tan ni/ gsum rig gtsang ma dag pa ste/ /mngon shes drug ldan rjes dran drug /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po 'jig rten 'das/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mtha'/ /shes rab kyi ni de nyid thob/ /bdag rig gzhan rig thams cad pa/ /kun la phan pa'i gang zag mchog /dper bya kun las 'das pa ste/ /shes dang shes bya'i bdag po mchog /ces pa la gsum rig ste/ sngon gyi mtha' rig pa dang phyi ma'i mtha' rig pa dang / zag pa zad pa rig pa mthar thug pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gtsang ma ste/ nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyi mi gtsang ba thams cad bdag med pa'i chu tshogs kyis bkrus pa'i phyir/

dag pa ste/ de nyid kyis na nyes pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ngo bo nyid kyi phyir/ mngon shes drug dang ldan pa ste/ lha'i mig dang / lha'i rna ba dang / pha rol gyi sems shes pa dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi bya ba shes pa dang / zag pa zad pa'i mngon par shes pa rnams dang / rtag tu mi 'bral ba'i phyir/ rjes dran drug dang ldan pa ste/ sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun dang / tshul khrims dang / gtong ba dang / lha rjes su dran pa rnams dang rtag tu ldan pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' ste/ rang gi don phun sum tshogs pa la sems pa'i blo dang ldan pa'i phyir/ sems dpa' chen po ste/ gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa la sems pa'i blo dang ldan pa'i phyir/ rdzu 'phrul chen po can te/ rnam pa thams cad du yul che ba'i rdzu 'phrul brnyes pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten las 'das pa ste/ zag pa med pa'i ye shes thugs su chud pas 'khor ba'i chu bo las brgal ba'i phyir/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i mtha' ste/ chos rab du rnam 'byed mthar phyin pa dang ldan pa'i chos kyi sku brnyes pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi ni de nyid thob pa ste/ shes rab kyi de kho na nyid gnyis med ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i phyir/ bdag rig pa ste/ so so rang gi rig pa mthar thug pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan rig pa ste/ sgyu ma lta bu'i sems can rnams rig pa'i phyir dang / de rnams la rang rig ye shes khong du chud par mdzad pa'i phyir/ thams cad pa ste/ rgyu ba dang / mi rgyu ba'i dngos po thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid chos kyi dbyings su bye brag med pa'i phyir/ kun la phan pa'i gang zag mchog ste/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba rdzogs par mdzad cing / thams cad kyi gtso bor gyur pa'i phyir skyes bu yin pa'i phyir/ dper bya kun las 'das pa ste/ gang dang yang mnyam pa med par mtshon par nus pa'i dpe dang bral ba'i phyir/

shes dang shes bya'i bdag po mchog ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pas shes pa dang / mtho ris dang / thar pa thams cad kyi rgyur gyur pas shes bya dang / de kho na nyid kyi ye shes ma lus pa la dbang sgyur zhing thams cad las phul du byung ba'i phyir ro/ ༈ /gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ btso bo chos kyi sbyin bdag ste/ /phyag rgya bzhi po'i don ston pa/ /'gro ba'i bsnyen bkur gnas kyi mchog /nges 'byung gsum po bgrod rnams kyi/ /don gyi dam pa rnam dag dpal/ /'jig rten gsum na skal bzang che/ /dpal ldan 'byor pa kun byed pa/ /'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog /ces pa la/ gtso bo chos kyi sbyin bdag ste/ chos kyi sbyin pa ni sbyin pa thams cad kyi gtso bo yin la/ de nyid skal ba ji lta ba bzhin stsol bas sbyin bdag rnams kyi mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir/ phyag rgya bzhi po'i don ston pa ste/ phyag rgya chen po dang / dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang / chos kyi phyag rgya dang / las kyi phyag rgya rnams kyi don ston par mdzad pa'i phyir/ de la phyag rgya chen po ni lha dang rjes su mthun par byed pa yin pas/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'o/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni thugs kyi ngo bo nyid yin pas so so rang gi rig pa chos kyi sku'o/ /chos kyi phyag rgya ni/ chos kyi longs spyod kyi byin rlabs las chos nyid kyi de kho na nyid ston pa'i gsang sngags kyi yi ge'i bdag nyid can sna tshogs pa'o/ /las kyi phyag rgya ni/ bya ba sgrub pa'i ngo bo nyid du gyur pas sprul pa'i mdzad pa sna tshogs pa rdzogs par byed pa sprul pa'i sku'o/ /'gro ba'i bsnyen bkur gnas kyi mchog ste/ nyes pa tham cad las 'das shing / yon tan thams cad kyi rang bzhin can yin la/ thar pa thams cad dang / phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bskyed par mdzad pa'i phyir/ 'gro ba ji lta bu'i bsnyen bkur gyi gnas yin snyam na/

nges 'byung gsum po bgrod rnams kyi zhes te/ theg pa gsum gyi nges par 'byung ba las ma gtogs pa'i lam gzhan dag gi nges par 'byung ba mi srid pas/ lam gsum po bgrod pa rnams kyis bsnyen cing bkur ba'i gnas kyi mchog yin pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i rje btsun 'jam dpal de nyid ni dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog ste/ don gyi dam pa chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i dpal dang ldan pa'i phyir dang / 'jig rten gsum na skal bzang che ba ste/ thams cad kyi mngon par 'dod pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad yang dag par rdzogs par mdzad pa'i phyir/ de nyid kyis na/ dpal ldan 'byor pa kun byed pa ste/ legs pa thams cad sgrub par byed pa'i phyir/ de ltar na tshul de dag gis ni/ 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog ces mtshan bsdus pa'i don legs par grub pa ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid du gyur pa'ang de nyid yin no zhes nges par bzung ba yin no/ ༈ /gnyis pa ye shes lnga'i don bsdu ba ni/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ /yang dag mthar gyur khyod la 'dud/ /stong nyid las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas byang chub khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas chags pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dod la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'dzum pa khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas bzhad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /sangs rgyas gsung nyid khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas thugs la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /med pa las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba khyod la 'dud/ /nam mkha' las byung khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes las byung khyod la 'dud/ /sgyu 'phru drwa ba khyod la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas rol ston khyod la 'dud/ /thams cad thams cad khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud/ /ces te/ mtshan don thams cad bsdu ba'i sgo nas/ bcom ldan 'das de rnam pa thams cad du mchod par 'os pa yin no/

/zhes ston cing / mtshan thams cad don ji lta ba nyid du bden pa'i mtshan nyid can yin par khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir/ tshigs su bcad pa lngas phyag 'tshal ba'i khyad par gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs rnams rangs par mdzad pa las/ dang po me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog ste/ mchog tu gyur pa sangs rgyas nyid stsol zhing / tshul de la rdo rje ltar mi phyed pas na/ thams cad kyi mchog gam gtso bor gyur pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i rje btsun 'jam dpal khyod la 'dud do/ /zhes bod pa'i sgo nas gus pas phyag 'tshal ba'o/ /de bzhin du gzhan la'ang sbyar ro/ /kye yang dag mthar gyur zhes te/ yang dag pa'i mtha' de bzhin nyid dri mas dag pa mthar thug pa'i ngo bo nyid du gyur pa'i phyir/ stong nyid las byung ste/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin las rab tu byung ba'i phyir ram/ stong pa nyid bsgoms pa las rab tu skyes pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas byang chub ste/ byang chub gsum las yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mthar thug pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ ༈ chos dbyings ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ sangs rgyas chags pa ste/ sangs rgyas rnams la shin tu chags shing zhen nas/ de'i ngo bor gnas pa'i phyir ram/ de kho na nyid thugs su chud cing sangs rgyas pa'i chags pa sems can thams cad rjes su dga' ba yin pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas 'dod pa ste/ 'gro ba rnams sgrol zhing 'don par bzhed pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir ram/ sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo nyid kun tu bzang po la 'dod pa rab tu ston pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas dgyes pa ste/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi dgyes pa'i ngo bo'am/ sangs rgyas rnams la rab tu dgyes pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas rol pa ste/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi rol pa'i ngo bo yin pa'am/ sangs rgyas rnams la rol par mdzad pa'i phyir/

༈ sor rtog ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ sangs rgyas 'dzum pa ste/ de kho na nyid thugs su chud pas zhal gyi padma kha bye ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas bzhad pa ste/ rmad du byung ba'i don ston cing byang sems chen po lung ston pa'i ltas su gyur pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer chen po 'phro ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas gsung nyid de/ dam pa'i chos rab tu ston pas sems can rnams gdul bar mdzad pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas thugs te/ rnam pa thams cad du yang sangs rgyas kyi thugs de'i rang bzhin nyid du gyur pa'i phyir/ ༈ mnyam nyid ye shes kyi sgo na bstod pa ni/ med pa las byung ste/ bden pa'i dngos po med pa las sam/ skye ba med pa las skye ba'i cho 'phrul du byung ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba ste/ 'di las sangs rgyas rnams 'byung ba'i phyir ram/ 'di nyid sangs rgyas rnams las byung ba'i phyir/ nam mkha' las byung ste/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i chos kyi dbyings las nges par byung ba'i phyir/ ye shes las byung ste/ gnyis su med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi ye shes las yang dag par byung ba'i phyir/ ༈ bya grub ye shes kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba ste/ sprul pa'i spros pa ma lus pa sems can 'dren pa'i thabs su gyur pa thams cad yang dag par ston par mdzad pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas rol ston te/ rgyan dang / cha lugs dang / gos dang / nyams kyi rnam par bkod pa sna tshogs pas rtse zhing rol par mdzad pa'i phyir/ thams cad thams cad de/ ji skad bshad pa'i rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i yon tan gyi rang bzhin thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i phyir/ ye shes sku nyid de/ de dag thams cad kyang ye shes kyi sku las tha mi dad cing ye shes kyi sku'i nus mthu las de ltar so sor snang ba nyid yin pa'i phyir/ sngags don las/ da ni rnam par snang mdzad chen po la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid kyi tshigs bcad rnams kyis/

bcom ldan 'das ye shes kyi spyi gzugs rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus na bzhugs pa la bstod par bya'o/ /zhes mtshams sbyar nas gzhung mtshams 'byed pa tsam las gzhan ma bshad do/ ༈ /gsum pa gzhung gi phan yon nam che ba bstan pa ni/ shin tu rtogs par sla ba dang / tshig mang su dogs pas 'dir ma bkrol la/ shes par 'dod pa rnams kyis gzhung gi mchan bur bkral yod pas der shes par bya'o/ ༈ /bzhi pa rtsa ba dang phreng ba'i sngags bstan pa ni/ oṃ sarba dharma a bhā ba/ swa bha ba/ bi shuddhe badzra tsakṣu/ a āḥ/ pra kṛ ti pa ri shuddhāḥ sarba dharma/ ya du ta/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ dzñā na kā ya/ mañdzu shrīḥ pa ri shuddhi tā/ mu pā dā ya ti/ a āḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ hri da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥ bha ga wan/ dzñā na murt+ti/ wa gi shwa ri/ ma hā pa tsa/ sarba dharmā/ ga ga na/ a ma la su pa ri shuddha/ dharma dhā tu/ dzñā na garba āḥ zhes te/ 'di la 'grel pa gnyis las/ mtshams sbyar ba dang / dka' ba'i gnas che long tsam las ma bshad mod/ go bde bar brjod na/ thog mar oṃ ni rdo rje rtse mo las/ oṃ ni ci zhig yin par brjod/ /mchog dang nor ster dpal dang g.yang / /skal bzang rnam pa dang ldan zhing / /dam bca' ba dang bkra shis don/ /nor bu 'dzin pa'i snying po yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ dam bca' ba dang / bkra shis pa dang / sngags kyi mgo 'dren pa'i phyir ro/ sarba dharma ni chos thams cad/ a bhā ba ni dngos po med pa/ swa bha ba ni rang bzhin/ bi shuddhe ni rnam par dag pa ste/ chos thams cad bden pa'i dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa zhes pa ste/ de yang badzra zhes pa rdo rje ste/ mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pas mi phyed pa'i phyir ro/ /tsakṣu zhes pa 'grel chen na med cing / sngags don las bshad pa ltar na mig ste snga ma dang 'brel bas/ thams cad du thogs pa med par 'jug pa'i rdo rje'i spyan ni rang bzhin rnam par dag pa yul du byed pa'o/

/de nas yi ge a ni skye ba med pa ste/ don dam pa'i byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid can no/ /ā ni sa dang pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa sbyong ba'i ngo bo nyid do/ /aṃ ni sangs rgyas nyid ston pa'o/ /aḥni mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston par byed pa'o/ /pra kṛ ti pa ri shuddha ni rang bzhin gyis yongs su dag pa ste gnas lugs so/ /gang gi ni sarba dharma zhes pa chos thams cad kyi'o/ /ya du ta ni ji lta ba bzhin te ma bcos pa'i don to/ /sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na kā ya/ mañdzu shrī ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi sku 'jam dpal te/ de yang pa ri shuddhi tā zhes pa yongs su dag pa nyid de/ dag pa gnyis mthar thug pa'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'i phyir/ mu pā dā ya ti ni/ khas blangs pa ste/ ye shes kyi sku de nyid bzung bar bya'o zhes dam 'cha' ba'o/ /yang a ni rang bzhin gyis dag pa'o/ /āḥni ye shes kyi skur byin gyis rlob par byed pa'o/ /oṃ ni sngar bzhin la/ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po zhes pa ste bod pa'o/ /ha ra ha ra ni 'phrog 'phrog zhes pa ste/ sgrib pa gnyis 'phrog shig pa'o/ /oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥni sku dang gsung dang thugs byin gyis rlobs par byed pa'o/ /bha ga wan dzñā na murt+ti wa gi shwa ra/ ma hā pa tsa ni/ bcom ldan 'das ye shes kyi sku/ ngag gi dbang phyug smin pa chen po'am/ smra ba chen po ste mtshan gyi sngags so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang / sarba dharma ga ga na/ a ma la ni/ chos thams cad nam mkha' dri ma med pa/ su pa ri shuddha ni shin tu yongs su dag pa/ dharma dhā tu dzñā na garbha ni/ chos dbyings ye shes snying po zhes pa ste/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nam mkha' ltar dri ma med cing / shin tu yongs su dag pa'i chos dbyings mthar thug pa dang / dbyer mi phyed pa'i ye shes kyi snying po'am mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir/

zhes pa'o/ /slar yang / aḥzhes pa ni chos kyi skur rgyas gdab pa'i don du 'dir gsungs pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /zhes 'grel chen las so/ /spyi don gsum pa rgyud don yongs su rdzogs pas mjug bsdu ba ni/ de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang / /dga' zhing mgu nas thal mo sbyar/ /mgon po bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la phyag mtshal nas/ /de ni mgon po gsang ba'i bdag /lag na rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal/ /sna tshogs gzhan dang lhan cig tu/ /gsang bstod nas ni tshig 'di gsol/ /mgon po bdag cag yi rang ngo / /legs so legs so legs par gsungs/ /rnam grol 'bras bu 'tshal ba yi/ /'gro ba mgon med rnams dang ni/ /bdag cag yang dag rdzogs pa yi/ /byang chub thob pa'i don chen mdzad/ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i tshul bstan pa/ /'di ni rnam dag legs pa'i lam/ /zab cing yangs la rgya che ste/ /don chen 'gro ba'i don byed pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi yul 'di ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis bshad/ /ces gsungs te/ 'di la yang dang por mtshams sbyar ba ni/ gsang sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rjes thogs de nas/ dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang rang don yongs su rdzogs pas dga' zhing / gzhan don yongs su rdzogs pas mgu nas/ gus pa'i spyod lam dang ldan pas/ thal mo sbyar te/ 'gro ba'i mgon po bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal nas/ zhu ba po'i gtso bo de ni mgon po gsang ba'i bdag po ste/ 'khor lag na rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po sna tshogs pa gzhan rnams dang lhan cig tu skad kyi gsang bstod nas ni/ tshig 'di skad gsol to/ /zhes pa ste tshig gi don gzhan rnams ni sngar bshad pa ltar ro/ /yid rangs shing mngon par bstod pa'i tshig dngos ni/ mgon po zhes bos nas bdag cag thams cad yid rang ngo / /ci'i phyir na legs so legs so zhes lan gnyis su bsngags nas legs par gsungs pa'i phyir te/

rnam grol gyi 'bras bu rdzogs byang 'tshal zhing don du gnyer ba'i 'gro ba mgon med pa gzhan rnams dang ni/ bdag cag 'dir 'dus pa rnams yang dag par rdzogs pa yi byang chub thob pa'i don chen po mdzad pa'i phyir/ thabs ji lta bus na sngar bshad pa ltar sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i tshul bstan pa 'di ni/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i phyir dang / nges pa legs pa'i lam dam pa/ zab cing yangs la rgya che ba ste/ de nyid kyis na don chen po 'gro ba'i don thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i don 'di ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod yul kho na ste/ 'di la sangs rgyas nyid tshad mar gyur pa yin gyi/ nyan thos la sogs pa rnams kyi yul ma yin pa'i phyir/ des na 'di ni dus gsum gyi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi bshad de/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /zhes sogs rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa sngar bshad zin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa 'jug gi don ni/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i don dam pa ste/ nges don gyi dbang du byas pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas gsungs pa rdzogs so// //de nyid rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrāddha ka ra warma ste dad byed go cha dang / ka ma la gub ta ste padma sbas pa dang / zhus chen gyi lo tstsha ba sprul pa'i skyes mchog dge slong rin chen bzang pos rgya skad las bod skad du bsgyur cing zhus dag byas te 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab pa'o// //rab 'byams rgyal ba'i yab nyid rgyal sras thu bo'i tshul gyis ma lus 'gro ba'i don rnams mtha' dag sgrub mdzad pa/ /'jam dbyangs mtshan tsam dran pas nyes pa kun las rnam par grol zhes dri med lung dang rigs pas nges gyur nas/ /'phur lding dbang po'i rjes su 'dab chags gzhan ltar 'jam dpal sprul pa 'jam dpal grags pa sogs kyi rjes 'brangs te/

/gsung rab snying po rgyud mchog mthar thug mtshan don brjod pa'i tshig don cha tsam shin tu gsal bar bdag gis phye/ /snyigs dus skye bo phal cher blo dman zhing / /phyogs lhung zhen lta'i skyon gyis rnam par bsgribs/ /tshul dang tshul min 'byed pa'i mthu med pa/ /de phyir legs bshad don du gnyer ba dkon/ /deng dus 'di na mkhas rnams dga' bskyed pa'i/ /dam pa'i smra bas mgu bar nus min te/ /legs sbyar skad kyis kla klo'i tshogs ci bzhin/ /de bas rnam 'grel 'di yang spangs su dogs/ /de lta mod kyi ring nas goms pa'i mthus/ /chos la mos pa'i bag chags brtan ldan pa'i/ /blo gsal rnams kyi blo gros rgyas phyir dang / /rnam dag lam la bdag blo goms phyir ro/ /rdo rje'i tshig don shin tu phyed dka' zhing / /bdag kyang byis pa'i blo yi skyon chags pas/ /gal te 'di la nongs pa'i tshogs mchis na/ /sngags rig mkhas pa rnams la bdag 'chags so/ /'dir 'bad dge bas mkha' mnyam 'gro ba rnams/ /kun mkhyen gsung rab rgya mtshor dbang bsgyur nas/ /rnam grol dga' ston dpal la nyer spyod de/ /'jam dbyangs ye shes mngon du 'gyur bar shog /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /'jam dbyangs bla mas rtag tu rjes 'dzin cing / /gzungs spobs ting 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dpal ldan pas/ /rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las sgrub par shog /khyad par skal ngan 'gro ba'i smag rum tu/ /lta ba'i tshang tshing mtha' dag sreg pa dang / /sa gsum 'gro la lam bzang gsal byed pa'i/ /bstan pa'i sgron me chen por bdag gyur cig /thos pa rgya mtshor kun tu thogs med cing / /bsam byung nor bu 'bar ba'i dga' ston dang / /sgom byung ye shes mchog la sbyor mdzad pa/ /bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// //ces pa 'di ni legs bshad don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa dang / rtogs par nus pa'i blo gros dang ldan pa sdom brtson rig pa 'dzin pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis nan tan gyis bskul zhing /
